Experience with Data Analysis S/W such as Galaxy, Data Conductor or DataPower to create Characterization Reports and monitor production Yield
Experience recruiting, managing, and mentoring an engineering team
BS in Electrical Engineering or related + 13 years of experience, or MS + 11 years of experience, or Ph.D. + 8 years of experience

MaxLinear has a Total Compensation philosophy which includes base salary and annual discretionary bonus eligibility and many positions also include stock-based compensation.

We have approximately 1,200 employees, a substantial majority of whom have engineering degrees and include masters and Ph.D. graduates from many of the premiere universities around the world. About The Role

We're modernizing how ComPsych builds technology — new customer-facing web and mobile experiences, a unified design system, and AI-powered capabilities across our products. That means raising the engineering bar for how we design, build, and operate software, with Engineering, Product, and Design working together end to end.

AI is part of how we engineer, not a productivity add-on. Our engineers use agentic development as standard equipment — writing clear specs, delegating meaningful work to AI agents, and applying strong technical judgment to what comes back. Our platform carries behavioral health data for millions of members, so reliability, privacy, and correctness are non-negotiable — not a tax on velocity. As a Senior Engineering Manager, your organization is your product: you're accountable for what multiple teams ship, how the group operates as AI changes the job, and the managers and engineers who grow under your leadership. Your job isn't to run any one team day to day — it's to create the conditions, standards, and talent pipeline that let several strong teams move with high ownership and autonomy.

What You'll Do

You're accountable for the organization you lead — delivery, technical judgment, production health, and how your teams work with AI — operating across multiple teams rather than inside a single one:

Build and grow a strong engineering organization, not just a single team. Create clarity, accountability, and growth so multiple teams — and the managers or leads within them — can take on increasing scope and perform at a high bar.
Create a credible delivery system across teams. Make priorities, ownership, dependencies, and capacity visible across the group you lead, and resolve the tradeoffs that no single team can make on its own.
Partner with Product and Design leadership on outcomes and execution at the domain level. Get pulled into discovery early, turn business priorities into executable plans across teams, and negotiate scope directly when AI-driven planning speed outpaces what engineering can safely validate and ship.
Hold the engineering bar across your organization. Ensure important technical decisions get the right depth of review everywhere you're accountable, and build the standards that make good judgment repeatable without your direct involvement in every decision.
Own the health of what your organization puts into production. Make sure every team you're accountable for can operate what it ships and respond effectively when things fail, and use delivery, quality, and reliability signals to know where to intervene and fix structural causes rather than recurring symptoms.
Set how your organization works with AI, and shape talent and standards around it. Define the delegation, verification, and review practices multiple teams adopt, evolve hiring and leveling criteria to reflect AI-native skills, and mentor other managers on coaching their engineers through the same shift.

You've led engineers and managers through the hard parts of scaling an organization. You've set expectations, coached people at different levels, managed performance, supported career growth and promotions, and handled difficult conversations directly — across more than one team.
You have technical depth engineers and managers trust, across more than one technical domain. You can engage meaningfully in design reviews for Java, Python, C#, or similar systems, challenge API contracts and data models, and reason about failure modes and testing strategy well enough to hold other managers accountable for the same rigor.
You've owned production engineering across multiple teams running on AWS or Azure. You've been accountable for observability, SLOs, on-call, incident response, and postmortem follow-through at a scale beyond a single team's services.

Clearly communicate BU strategic priorities and function strategy to enable team understanding and alignment.

Waymo is an autonomous driving technology company with the mission to be the world's most trusted driver. Since its start as the Google Self-Driving Car Project in 2009, Waymo has focused on building the Waymo Driver—The World's Most Experienced Driver™—to improve access to mobility while saving thousands of lives now lost to traffic crashes. The Waymo Driver powers Waymo’s fully autonomous ride-hail service and can also be applied to a range of vehicle platforms and product use cases. The Waymo Driver has provided over ten million rider-only trips, enabled by its experience autonomously driving over 100 million miles on public roads and tens of billions in simulation across 15+ U.S. states.

At Waymo, we are building the world's most trusted driver. The Global Places and Services (GPS) team acts as the backbone of Waymo's physical and technical operational infrastructure, balancing technical engineering expertise with operational agility to protect and optimize our environments as autonomous vehicle technology scales.

As Waymo transitions from R&D to global commercial scale, our physical facility controls and cloud IT infrastructure must evolve to be seamlessly integrated. We are seeking an Head of Technical Services to serve as our Master Systems Integrator (MSI) and top-level technical authority. In this role, you will bridge physical building operations and digital cloud platforms, defining long-term network architectures for Building Automation Systems (BAS) and Building Operating System (BOS) service frameworks. BAS & BOS Technical Architecture: Define the technical direction and global network architecture for Building Automation Systems (BAS) and Building Operating System (BOS) platforms, prioritizing system sustainability, enterprise scalability, and long-term risk mitigation

The Donovan's Venom, INC. Is a non-profit 501(c)(3) tax exempt organization dedicated to taking music, art, and entertainment to those who need it the most. The Donovan's Venom, INC. Caters to no particular individual(s) yet pledges relief to impaired or deprived individuals who are in need of musical,visual, comedic, and-or any alternative forms of liberation-through fine art & entertainment. The Donovan's Venom INC. Gives its resources to individuals who don't have the means or access.

,

About Us

The Donovan’s Venom is a 501c3 nonprofit organization focused on curating universal accessibility to fine arts and music education for all. We are passionately dedicated to ensuring that everyone, regardless of financial circumstances, has access to high-quality music education, performance opportunities, and fine art. We aim to inspire, empower, and uplift communities by fostering a love for music and the arts through our commitment to education, inclusivity, diversity, and social impact, which drives us to expand our reach continually and enrich the lives of those we serve.

Position Overview

The Donovan’s Venom is seeking a high-impact Volunteer Director of Software Engineering to lead software engineering execution and delivery across our technology initiatives.

This is a hands-on leadership opportunity for an experienced engineering professional who can translate organizational priorities into clear technical plans, organize distributed volunteer teams, remove roadblocks, and consistently drive projects toward completion.

The Director of Software Engineering will serve as a critical bridge between the organization's mission, the CTO, and our engineering volunteers. The primary focus is execution over perfection—creating the structure, processes, and accountability needed to help volunteer engineers deliver scalable, secure, and reliable software with minimal administrative overhead.

The ideal candidate combines strong technical judgment with exceptional project coordination, communication, and people leadership skills. Experience leading distributed, remote, volunteer, or open-source engineering teams is highly valued.

Key Responsibilities

Engineering Execution & Delivery
Drive Engineering Velocity Establish and maintain an execution-focused roadmap that enables decentralized volunteer teams to deliver high-quality software predictably.
Translate Priorities Into Action Break organizational and technical goals into clear, actionable initiatives, milestones, and engineering tasks.
Streamline Developer Onboarding Improve documentation, development environments, workflows, and tooling so new volunteers can become productive quickly.
Remove Roadblocks Proactively identify and resolve technical, operational, process, and documentation bottlenecks.
Establish Delivery Processes Implement practical processes for sprint planning, task tracking, code reviews, releases, and project status reporting.
Maintain Pragmatic Quality Promote automated testing, appropriate code review standards, CI/CD, monitoring, and deployment practices.
Track Progress Maintain visibility into project status, dependencies, risks, blockers, and upcoming deliverables.
Technical Leadership & Architecture
Maintain Technology Alignment Ensure engineering teams follow established architectural principles and make appropriate use of Next.js, React, Vercel, TypeScript, Bun, and Azure.
Guide Backend Architecture Provide technical leadership around microservices, APIs, asynchronous processing, service communication, and scalable application design.
Optimize Cloud Infrastructure Work with the technology team to improve Azure infrastructure performance, reliability, security, and cost efficiency.
Manage Cloud Resources Help maximize nonprofit cloud credits and available infrastructure grants while maintaining appropriate availability and security.
Balance Technical Debt and Delivery Make pragmatic technical decisions that balance long-term maintainability with immediate organizational priorities.
Promote Security Ensure engineering practices incorporate appropriate application, infrastructure, access-control, and data-security considerations.
Volunteer Engineering Leadership
Coordinate Engineering Volunteers Organize and support distributed contributors working across flexible schedules and varying levels of availability.
Coach & Mentor Help engineers improve their technical skills, development practices, and understanding of the organization's systems.
Match Skills to Priorities Assign projects and tasks based on volunteer expertise, interests, availability, and organizational priorities.
Create Accountability Establish clear ownership, expectations, deadlines, and communication practices while maintaining a supportive volunteer environment.
Recognize Contributions Foster an environment where volunteer contributions are visible, valued, and connected to measurable community impact.
Cross-Functional Collaboration
Partner closely with the CTO to translate technology strategy into executable engineering plans.
Collaborate with product, operations, program, and other organizational leaders to understand priorities and dependencies.
Communicate engineering progress, risks, resource needs, and delivery timelines to technical and non-technical stakeholders.
Participate in technology leadership and cross-functional planning meetings.
Help ensure engineering priorities remain aligned with the organization's mission and community needs.

Professional Experience

Required Skills & Experience

6+ years of professional software engineering experience.
Demonstrated experience leading engineering teams, technical projects, open-source repositories, or distributed development efforts.
Experience coordinating multiple projects, contributors, or technical workstreams.
Experience working in remote or asynchronous environments.
Experience managing technical volunteers or distributed, part-time engineering teams is highly desirable.

Technical Proficiency

Frontend

Strong familiarity with Next.js and React.
Experience with Vercel and modern web deployment practices.
Understanding of edge routing, caching, performance optimization, and modern web application architecture.

Backend

Strong experience building backend services using TypeScript.
Experience with Bun and/or Node.js.
Strong understanding of RESTful APIs, service boundaries, asynchronous processing, and scalable backend architecture.

Cloud & Infrastructure

Practical experience with Microsoft Azure.
Familiarity with services such as
Azure App Services
Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS)
Azure Functions
Azure Cosmos DB
Azure Event Hubs

Understanding of cloud cost optimization, resource management, security, and availability.
Experience working with nonprofit cloud credits or grants is a plus.

Architecture

Strong understanding of microservices architecture.
Experience designing clean, maintainable APIs.
Understanding of distributed systems and asynchronous/event-driven architectures.
Familiarity with CI/CD, automated testing, observability, and modern DevOps practices.

Leadership & Execution Competencies

The successful candidate should demonstrate

Exceptional project management and organizational skills.
Strong ability to prioritize and execute in a resource-constrained environment.
Excellent written and asynchronous communication skills.
Ability to coordinate contributors across different schedules and time zones.
Strong problem-solving and decision-making abilities.
High empathy and emotional intelligence.
Ability to establish accountability without creating unnecessary bureaucracy.
Ability to communicate technical concepts clearly to non-technical stakeholders.
A mission-first, execution-oriented mindset.
Ability to distinguish between issues that require immediate action and those that can be addressed later.

What This Opportunity Offers

Your work will directly support technology initiatives that advance The Donovan’s Venom's mission and serve the community.
Lead engineering initiatives using a modern technology ecosystem including Next.js, React, Vercel, TypeScript, Bun, and Microsoft Azure.
Build and demonstrate experience leading distributed engineering teams, shaping technical execution, and managing large-scale software initiatives in a nonprofit environment.
Collaborate with passionate engineers, technology professionals, organizational leaders, and volunteers from diverse backgrounds.
The role is designed around a remote and asynchronous operating model, allowing volunteers to contribute around their existing professional and personal commitments.
Gain meaningful leadership experience and the opportunity to demonstrate measurable technical and organizational impact through mission-driven projects.

Panorama Education is a technology company building the leading platform for student insight and action in K-12. We help modern school systems understand what students need and take effective action. Join us and help shape what education looks like for the next generation.

About the Role

As the Senior Engineering Manager for Platform, you'll lead the team behind the foundational capabilities that power Panorama's products: shared services, core infrastructure, developer tooling, and operational standards. You'll own how the team builds, delivers, and operates that foundation, and you'll grow the engineers who do the work.
This role pairs closely with the Lead Product Manager, Platform to set direction and deliver on it. Reporting to the Director of Engineering, you'll manage a team of senior and staff engineers. Your job is to keep the platform solid as Panorama grows, so teams can build on it quickly and securely without inheriting debt down the line. As Panorama invests more heavily in AI across the product and internally, the platform is what makes that work durable and safe to run at scale.
This is a team with real technical strength and a wide, growing surface area, which gives this role real room to shape how the team scales. You'll partner closely with a newly-arriving Lead Product Manager to build the roadmap and working cadence together from day one, and help translate Panorama's growing investment in AI into practices the team can rely on.

Requirements

What You'll Do

Lead the team. Build and grow a team of senior and staff-level platform engineers. Set a high bar, give direct feedback, and hold people to clear expectations while keeping the team moving fast.
Guide technical direction. Partner with staff engineers on architecture and tradeoffs across infrastructure, shared services, and system design, including the infrastructure that AI-powered capabilities depend on. Keep the team on the highest-leverage work and unblock complex execution.
Own delivery and platform health. Ship platform initiatives reliably from planning through production. Define what platform health means and drive the work that gets there: performance, resiliency, cost efficiency, and operational maturity. Build strong on-call and incident practices with SRE, and triage reactive work without losing the strategic thread.
Support AI workloads. Partner with the AI platform and security teams so that AI-powered capabilities run on infrastructure that is observable, cost-aware, and secure. Bring the same operational standards to this work that you bring to everything else the platform carries. You'll also help the team engage with AI-assisted development itself, bringing real, thoughtful adoption of new tools and workflows. 
Partner with product. Shape the roadmap with the Lead Product Manager and turn strategy into buildable plans. Bring engineer-identified pain points, system health signals, and technical risk into prioritization, and turn them into resourced, well-scoped work.
Lead across functions. Represent platform engineering across teams. Drive alignment on multi-team initiatives, and give leadership honest updates on progress, risk, and the reasoning behind technical investment.
Keep security at the forefront. Partner with security and legal, so platform capabilities support Panorama's security, privacy, and compliance obligations, with student data central to every decision.

8+ years of software engineering experience, including 5+ years managing engineers, ideally on platform, infrastructure, or developer experience teams
A track record of managing and growing senior and staff-level ICs, with a style rooted in clarity, trust, and example rather than formal authority
Technical credibility: hands-on and credible enough to earn trust fast with senior and staff engineers, with the technical taste to know which corners are fine to cut and which would create real technical debt.  Hands-on AWS background strongly preferred; Terraform and Kubernetes a significant plus

Developer experience focus: improves developer productivity through CI/CD, internal tooling, and self-service infrastructure, and can tie that to shipping velocity, incident reduction, and retention
Experience with security and compliance frameworks such as SOC 2 and FERPA, and a strong command of data protection and privacy practices
